actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: SocialGym-v0 is registered with entry point social_gym.social_nav_gym:SocialNavGym
SocialNavGym is both a gymnasium Env and a SocialNavSim
The action and observation spaces are dummy Discrete(1) spaces, declared just for registration
reset raises AttributeError when no robot has been set and accepts only the train, val and test phases
reset seeds numpy from the phase's case counter, not from a caller-supplied seed
reset puts the robot at the configured start pose, resets the simulator and installs both time steps
One environment step applies the same action for robot_time_step/time_step sub-steps and advances global time by time_step in each
The robot action is ActionXY(vx, vy) with holonomic kinematics and ActionRot(v, r) with unicycle kinematics
The unicycle update moves by v in the direction yaw+r and then adds r to yaw; the holonomic update moves by (vx, vy)
The repository's example env.config sets time_limit 50 s, time_step 0.0125 s and robot_time_step 0.25 s
configure reads the time steps and rejects a robot time step that is not a multiple of the time step
The observation is the list of the humans' observable states, computed by compute_humans_observable_state
An observable human state carries px, py, vx, vy and radius
The reward is zero and truncated at time_limit-1; a collision pays collision_penalty and terminates; reaching the goal pays success_reward and terminates; a close pass pays a discomfort penalty
The example env.config sets success_reward 1, collision_penalty -0.25, discomfort_dist 0.2 and discomfort_penalty_factor 0.5
The constructor starts the circular_crossing scenario with the robot inserted
The circular crossing generator defaults to 10 actors, a circle radius of 7 and a robot radius of 0.3

determinism.notes: the fake draws its one human's start offset from random.Random(seed) and then integrates deterministically, so one seed and one action sequence repeat an observation; the upstream reset seeds numpy from its phase case counter instead of a caller seed (social_gym/social_nav_gym.py:137), so the two do not repeat each other

gaps: the upstream action and observation spaces are dummy Discrete(1) values for registration (social_gym/social_nav_gym.py:55-57); the fake exposes the actual two-number robot action (ActionXY or ActionRot, crowd_nav/utils/action.py:3-4) as a Box and the five-number ObservableState of one human (crowd_nav/utils/state.py:24-30) instead of the ten-actor default (social_gym/social_nav_sim.py:209) or the five-human example configuration (crowd_nav/configs/env.config:23)
one simulated human with a constant velocity: no social force, headed social force or ORCA model, no walls or other humans and no pygame rendering
the upstream reset requires configure(config) and set_robot(robot) first (social_gym/social_nav_gym.py:59-98,125); the fake is self-contained and does not model those setup calls
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0; one step advances 0.25 s of simulated time, which is 20 sub-steps of the example time_step 0.0125 s (social_gym/social_nav_gym.py:240-245)
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment: gymnasium, pygame, scipy and torch are not importable where the gate ran, and the upstream package was not installed
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation and counters stay readable
